SkyblockFlow bundles the unmodified JLayer 1.0.1 library by JavaZoom and its
contributors for MP3 decoding and playback. JLayer is licensed under the
GNU Library General Public License version 2 or later; it is distributed
here under LGPL 2.1. SkyblockFlow's own source is licensed separately under MIT.

The LGPL 2.1 text is in JLAYER-LICENSE.txt. Corresponding JLayer sources are
included as jlayer-1.0.1-sources.jar, obtained from:
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/javazoom/jlayer/1.0.1/jlayer-1.0.1-sources.jar

JLayer is included as a separate nested JAR under META-INF/jars in the mod,
not merged into SkyblockFlow classes. It can be replaced with a compatible
modified JAR and the mod can be rebuilt with Gradle. The source project and
build configuration are included in the release source archive. No terms
of SkyblockFlow prohibit modification or reverse engineering for debugging
changes to this LGPL library.
